tasks.subject: Task 0: Scaffold work tree + authoritative targets.json
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create the review directory tree and the single authoritative unit matrix every later step derives from.

**Files:** Create docs/reviews/2026-06-20-numbox/targets.json and the findings/verified/{MEM,COR,DES,SEC,TST} + bin + prompts dirs.

**Acceptance Criteria:** valid JSON, all listed source paths exist, 29 targets / 89 review units, five-dimension findings+verified dirs present.

**Verify:** venv-python loads targets.json, asserts files exist, prints `targets: 29 review units: 89`.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["docs/reviews/2026-06-20-numbox/targets.json"], "verifyCommand": "/home/erik/projects/numbox/venv/bin/python -c \"import json,pathlib;b=pathlib.Path('/home/erik/projects/numbox');t=json.loads((b/'docs/reviews/2026-06-20-numbox/targets.json').read_text());print('review units:',sum(len(x['dimensions']) for x in t['targets']))\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["valid JSON, all paths exist", "29 targets, 89 review units", "five-dimension findings/ and verified/ dirs"]}
```
tasks.executionNote: targets.json built from current tree: 41 targets / 119 review units (spec est. 75, old tasks.json est. 89 both low; source grew).

tasks.subject: Task 1: Findings schema + per-dimension review prompts
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Lock the findings output shape and per-dimension review instructions.

**Files:** Create findings.schema.json and prompts/{MEM,COR,DES,SEC,TST,verify}.md.

**Acceptance Criteria:** schema valid JSON; six prompt files non-empty; each template enforces read-only source + single-file schema-conforming output.

**Verify:** load schema JSON; assert each prompt non-empty; print `task1 ok`.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["docs/reviews/2026-06-20-numbox/findings.schema.json", "docs/reviews/2026-06-20-numbox/prompts/MEM.md", "docs/reviews/2026-06-20-numbox/prompts/COR.md", "docs/reviews/2026-06-20-numbox/prompts/DES.md", "docs/reviews/2026-06-20-numbox/prompts/SEC.md", "docs/reviews/2026-06-20-numbox/prompts/TST.md", "docs/reviews/2026-06-20-numbox/prompts/verify.md"], "verifyCommand": "R=/home/erik/projects/numbox/docs/reviews/2026-06-20-numbox; /home/erik/projects/numbox/venv/bin/python -c \"import json;json.load(open('$R/findings.schema.json'))\" && for f in MEM COR DES SEC TST verify; do test -s \"$R/prompts/$f.md\"; done && echo task1 ok", "acceptanceCriteria": ["schema valid JSON", "six prompts non-empty", "templates enforce read-only + single-file output"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: pending.py resume engine + test
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Deterministic helper that reads targets.json + on-disk findings/verified and prints the ordered work queue (lossless resume).

**Files:** Create bin/pending.py and bin/test_pending.py.

**Acceptance Criteria:** empty tree summary = 89 review pending / 0 verify / complete false; completed findings file removes its review and exposes its verify; --next 10 prints <=10 reviews-before-verifies MEM-first; test passes.

**Verify:** run test_pending.py -> OK.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["docs/reviews/2026-06-20-numbox/bin/pending.py", "docs/reviews/2026-06-20-numbox/bin/test_pending.py"], "verifyCommand": "/home/erik/projects/numbox/venv/bin/python /home/erik/projects/numbox/docs/reviews/2026-06-20-numbox/bin/test_pending.py", "acceptanceCriteria": ["empty tree: 89 review pending, complete false", "findings file exposes its verify unit", "test prints OK"]}
```
tasks.executionNote: SUPERSEDED: bespoke pending.py resume engine replaced by the Workflow executor + deterministic disk aggregate (user chose "Workflow, full fan-out"). Resume handled by recomputing pending from on-disk findings/verified + agent self-skip.

**Files:** Create prompts/synthesis.md.

**Acceptance Criteria:** keep only confirmed, group MEM-first by severity; tasks.json one-per-finding/cluster with model/files/acceptanceCriteria; uncertain verdicts surfaced in Human-triage, never dropped.

**Verify:** `test -s prompts/synthesis.md && echo ok`.


tasks.subject: Task 5: Run the paced review to completion
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Execute the runbook (~180 agents at 10/hour ~18 batches) to committed REPORT.md + numbox-review.tasks.json, every batch durably committed.

**Files:** Create (during run) findings/**, verified/**, REPORT.md, numbox-review.tasks.json.

**Acceptance Criteria:** each batch <=10 agents committed before next wake; summary eventually complete:true with verify_done==review_total; REPORT.md confirmed-only MEM-first + Human-triage; tasks.json valid, every task has model; only docs/reviews/ touched, nothing pushed.

**Verify:** pending.py --summary complete:true; assert all tasks have model; git status clean.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["docs/reviews/2026-06-20-numbox/REPORT.md", "docs/reviews/2026-06-20-numbox/numbox-review.tasks.json"], "verifyCommand": "R=/home/erik/projects/numbox/docs/reviews/2026-06-20-numbox; /home/erik/projects/numbox/venv/bin/python \"$R/bin/pending.py\" --summary; git -C /home/erik/projects/numbox status --short", "acceptanceCriteria": ["each batch <=10 agents, committed before next wake", "summary complete:true verify_done==review_total", "REPORT.md confirmed-only MEM-first + Human-triage", "tasks.json valid, every task has model", "only docs/reviews touched, nothing pushed"]}
```
